# Database Architecture and Data Engineering
Map existing tabs, headers, IDs, backups, audits, and migrations before changing data behavior. Preserve historical records and lock-sensitive writes. Validate values and sheet identity. Use Test Mode resources only. Review backup and rollback implications for every schema or migration change.
